vocabulary.definition: a semiconductor device with two terminals, typically allowing the flow of current in one direction only
vocabulary.example: The LED lights used in indoor farming are actually diodes that emit specific wavelengths of light.

vocabulary.definition: a particle representing a quantum of light or other electromagnetic radiation
vocabulary.example: Plants absorb every photon of light energy to convert it into plant food through photosynthesis.

vocabulary.definition: the ability of living organisms to adapt to changes in their environment by altering their biological structure
vocabulary.example: Plants exhibit plasticity by manipulating their genes to thrive in the low-gravity environment of space.

vocabulary.definition: a condition in which objects appear weightless because they are in free fall towards a gravitational body, such as Earth
vocabulary.example: Plants in space experience microgravity, causing them to grow differently than on Earth.

vocabulary.definition: able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
vocabulary.example: Plants exposed to microgravity become more resilient, adapting genetically to stress and returning stronger to Earth.

vocabulary.definition: individual examples of a particular type of plant or animal for scientific study or collection
vocabulary.example: Genetically stronger plant specimens from space can offer valuable insights into growing food in varying climates on Earth.
